changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.comment: Backfills the overdue-installment charge snapshot for active loans using the product's current charge. Historical charge amounts are not recoverable, so pre-existing loans are pinned to today's amount rather than to the amount at their creation date. Closed and written-off loans are skipped: overdue charges are only ever applied to loans in status 300 (ACTIVE). When a product has more than one overdue-installment charge, the one with the lowest id is picked, consistent with LoanProduct#getOverdueInstallmentCharge().
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan SET overdue_charge_id = ( SELECT MIN(mc.id) FROM m_product_loan_charge plc JOIN m_charge mc ON mc.id = plc.charge_id -- charge_time_enum = 9 is ChargeTimeType.OVERDUE_INSTALLMENT, charge_applies_to_enum = 1 is loan charges WHERE plc.product_loan_id = m_loan.product_id AND mc.charge_time_enum = 9 AND mc.charge_applies_to_enum = 1), overdue_charge_amount = ( SELECT mc.amount FROM m_product_loan_charge plc JOIN m_charge mc ON mc.id = plc.charge_id WHERE plc.product_loan_id = m_loan.product_id AND mc.charge_time_enum = 9 AND mc.charge_applies_to_enum = 1 ORDER BY mc.id LIMIT 1) WHERE m_loan.loan_status_id = 300 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_product_loan_charge plc JOIN m_charge mc ON mc.id = plc.charge_id WHERE plc.product_loan_id = m_loan.product_id AND mc.charge_time_enum = 9 AND mc.charge_applies_to_enum = 1)
